title: Asahina Mafuyu — Delayed Reunion〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - School Gate
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade! Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mentioned this on Nightcord, but there's this one place where I think Mizuki will show up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, I'm gonna go there!
Would you two mind sticking around here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks!
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope we find Mizuki soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, what if Mizuki comes here instead...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We can let Ena know.
But I have a feeling that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: ...we shouldn't let Mizuki see that we're here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Us being here would be an indicator that Ena is too, which could cause problems if Mizuki wants to avoid her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, we should hide somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But where...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All the paths leading here are so open that there's nowhere to hide. We'll need to sneak on campus and hide in the bushes by the gate.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be able to remain hidden from anyone going in or out of the school here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Having to squat like this is going to be hard for me, but I'll deal with the pain somehow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In the event that Mizuki does discover us, we may want to say, “We came looking for Ena.”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, why?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Remember what I just said?
Us being here is a sign that Ena is also present.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By saying that we're looking for Ena, we can claim that our business is with her alone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's no way for Mizuki to know what we've been up to without logging in to Nightcord, which hasn't happened recently.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We could say that Ena's also stopped logging in and we haven't seen her for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you think Mizuki will want us to elaborate on that further...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We'd have to lie...
But as long as it keeps Mizuki from running.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, what if Mizuki runs without hearing what we have to say?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We'll just have to find a way to win this game of cat and mouse no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But Mizuki's really athletic, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When we played tag in SEKAI before, I don't think any of us was able to lay a finger on Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I guess someone can have the stamina of a student-athlete without actually playing for any clubs or teams.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'm sorry.
I don't think I'll be of much help if it comes to a footrace...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be fine as long as we know which streets Mizuki goes down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I basically memorized all of the streets, back alleys and side alleys around Kamiyama High the last time I came here to search.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What? A-All of them?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I know which streets go where, including where all the best shortcuts are.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Mizuki may miss or cut class a lot, but being a Kamiyama High student still gives the advantage here, so I felt that I needed to understand the lay of the land.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
W-Wow...
I didn't realize just how much effort you were putting into our search...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought it was necessary.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this, you two...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All that's left is to see if Mizuki actually appears...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We'll be waiting right here for you, Mizuki.
